task: Implement create_index for the search service without importing the search engine index logic.

candidate_memories.content: Search service create_index registers a new named index with its schema in the index registry.
Index schema registration is lightweight; it does not trigger data ingestion or shard allocation.
The search service create_index is a control-plane call; indexing data is a separate data-plane call.
When create_index spans control and data plane contexts, confirm the registration vs build model.
Search engine: create_index allocates shards, builds the inverted index, and writes to disk.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: shard allocation and index building belong to the data plane, not the registry call

candidate_memories.content: Old infra note says index creation and registration should be a single atomic operation.
